item.description:
### Fixed - **Amp's plan name is back on the usage strip.** Amp reworded its usage summary again and the "Megawatt" label silently disappeared. Perch reads the new wording, and from now on a usage fetch that returns fewer details than the one before it is written to the diagnostics bundle, so a change like this is visible instead of quiet.
### Added - **A session that is compacting its context says so.** Compaction can take a few minutes with nothing else happening, and the row used to keep showing the last tool as if it were still running. It now reads "Compacting context…" until compaction finishes. - **A tool that auto mode blocked is shown as blocked.** When Claude Code's auto mode refuses a tool, the row now says which one, instead of keeping the previous tool's line up. Nothing to approve: auto mode already decided. - **The diagnostics bundle lists your installed agent CLI versions** next to the version each usage parser was last checked against, so a stale parser is a question with an answer.
